stories.headline: TSMC posts record Q2 profit up 77%, raises 2026 growth outlook above 40% and capex to $64B

key_facts.fact: TSMC's Q2 net income hit a record NT$706.56 billion (~$21.98 billion), up 77.4% year over year and far above Bloomberg estimates of NT$623.73 billion — a fifth straight quarter of record profit.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC's net income for the three months to June 30 hit a record high of T$706.56 billion ($21.98 billion), much higher than Bloomberg estimates of T$623.73 billion. The figure was a 77.4% jump from the same period a year ago, and marked a fifth straight quarter of record-high profits for the chipmaker.

key_facts.fact: Quarterly revenue was a record NT$1.27 trillion (~$39-40.2 billion), up 36% year over year and at the high end of guidance, with gross margin of 67.7% beating the company's own forecast.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC said second-quarter revenue rose to $40.2 billion, topping the company's guidance range and coming in slightly above the $39.94 billion analyst forecast, while gross margin reached 67.7%, above expectations.

key_facts.fact: TSMC raised its full-year 2026 revenue growth outlook to slightly above 40% in US dollar terms, up from a prior forecast of over 30%.
key_facts.excerpt: Wei said TSMC's 2026 revenue is now expected to increase by more than 40% in U.S. dollar terms, higher than prior forecasts for growth of over 30%.

key_facts.fact: The company lifted 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $60-$64 billion from $52-$56 billion, a record high and roughly a 14% increase.
key_facts.excerpt: Meanwhile, the company also significantly raised its full-year capital expenditure budget from the previous $52 billion to $56 billion to $60 billion to $64 billion, representing an increase of approximately 14% and hitting a record high.

key_facts.fact: About 70-80% of the 2026 capital budget goes to advanced process technologies, 10% to specialty nodes and 10-20% to advanced packaging, testing and mask making.
key_facts.excerpt: About 70–80% of that will go to advanced process technologies, with 10% for specialty nodes and 10–20% for advanced packaging, testing, and mask making.

key_facts.fact: CEO C.C. Wei said 'The AI megatrend is stronger and stronger,' citing a 'very big' gap between customer demand and supply, and said agentic AI is reviving CPU demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Chairman and CEO C.C. Wei cited surging AI demand, including the rise of agentic AI that is reviving CPU demand, as the overwhelming driver. "The AI megatrend is stronger and stronger," Wei said, adding that the company's multi-year conviction is "very high." ... The aggressive spending commitments reflect what Wei called a "very big" gap between customer demand and supply.

key_facts.fact: TSMC shares closed at $419.48 but fell 1.55% in after-hours trading to $412.99 as investors weighed heavier spending and a forecast for lower margins in the current quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares were little changed during the regular session, closing at $419.48, but fell 1.55% in after-hours trading to $412.99 as investors weighed the company's heavier spending plans and a forecast for lower margins in the current quarter.

stories.headline: TSMC pledges another $100B for four new Arizona fabs, lifting its US commitment to $265B

key_facts.fact: CEO C.C. Wei said TSMC will invest an additional $100 billion to expand production capacity in Arizona, on top of its existing facilities in the state.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO C.C. Wei said the company will invest an additional $100 billion to increase its production capacity in the U.S. state of Arizona, adding to its facilities in the state. The company has three key manufacturing hubs across the globe-- in Taiwan, the U.S., and Japan.

key_facts.fact: The new commitment brings TSMC's total pledged US investment to $265 billion, funding four new fabs, with an ultimate goal of 10 wafer fabs and two packaging plants in the US.
key_facts.excerpt: Among these, TSMC confirmed an additional investment of $100 billion in Arizona, expanding its total investment scale to $265 billion to construct four chip factories, with the ultimate goal of establishing 10 wafer fabs and 2 packaging plants in the US.

key_facts.fact: The additional Arizona outlay targets 2-nanometer and below fabs plus advanced packaging.
key_facts.excerpt: To meet the demand, TSMC announced an additional $100 billion investment in Arizona for 2-nanometer and below fabs and advanced packaging, bringing its total Arizona outlay to $265 billion.

key_facts.fact: The new $100 billion commitment would include building four new chip fabrication plants for the contract chipmaker.
key_facts.excerpt: The new $100 billion commitment from TSMC would include building four new chip fabricating factories, known as fabs, for the company's contract ...

key_facts.fact: The pledge follows a January 2026 US-Taiwan trade deal in which Taiwanese companies committed $250 billion in US investment in exchange for lower tariffs; Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said the figure included $100 billion already committed by TSMC in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said Taiwan companies would invest $250 billion to boost production of semiconductors, energy and artificial intelligence in the United States. The figure includes $100 billion already committed by chipmaker TSMC in 2025, with more to come, he added.

stories.headline: Hyundai takes 100% of Boston Dynamics as SoftBank exercises put option on its 9.65% stake

key_facts.fact: Hyundai Motor Group disclosed on July 16 that it will make Boston Dynamics a wholly owned subsidiary by acquiring SoftBank Group's stake of around 10%, a move it says will help deploy advanced robotics across its operations.
key_facts.excerpt: SEOUL, July 16 : Hyundai Motor Group on Thursday disclosed that it would make U.S. robotics company Boston Dynamics a wholly owned subsidiary by acquiring SoftBank Group's stake of around 10 per cent, a move it said would help it deploy advanced robotics across its operations.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank exercised a put option on its 9.65% stake under a 2020 contract; terms were not disclosed, but local media reported the transaction would likely be worth about 500 billion won ($335 million).
key_facts.excerpt: Hyundai Motor Group announced on July 16 that Japan's SoftBank exercised its put option (right to sell common shares) for its 9.65% stake in Boston Dynamics, in accordance with a contract signed in 2020.

key_facts.fact: Terms were not disclosed; local media reported the deal would likely be worth about 500 billion won ($335 million), and Kiwoom Securities analyst Shin Yoonchul said the price implied a valuation of about 5 trillion won for Boston Dynamics.
key_facts.excerpt: Terms of the deal were not disclosed. Local media reported last month that the transaction would likely be worth about 500 billion won ($335 million). ... Shin Yoonchul, an analyst at Kiwoom Securities, said the transaction price implied a valuation of about 5 trillion won for Boston Dynamics.

key_facts.fact: Hyundai acquired an 80% controlling stake in Boston Dynamics from SoftBank in 2021 for about 1 trillion won ($671 million); the current structure is Hyundai Motor 28%, Chairman Euisun Chung 22.6%, Kia 17.2%, Hyundai Mobis 11.3%, Hyundai Glovis 11.25%.
key_facts.excerpt: The current ownership structure is Hyundai Motor with 28%, Kia with 17.2%, Hyundai Mobis with 11.3%, Hyundai Glovis with 11.25%, Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Euisun Chung with 22.6%, and SoftBank with 9.65%. ... Hyundai Motor Group has come to hold a 100% stake about five years after completing the acquisition of a controlling stake (80%) in Boston Dynamics from Japan's SoftBank for 1 trillion won (about $671 million) in 2021.

key_facts.fact: Boston Dynamics is pushing commercialization of the Atlas humanoid with a mass-production goal of 2028, and Hyundai is reviewing an IPO including a US Nasdaq listing.
key_facts.excerpt: Boston Dynamics is pushing for the commercialization of the humanoid robot Atlas and is expanding related businesses with the goal of mass production in 2028. ... Hyundai Motor Group is also reported to be reviewing an Initial Public Offering (IPO), including a listing of Boston Dynamics on the US Nasdaq market, from various angles.

key_facts.fact: Hyundai Motor shares have fallen more than 30% since local media first reported the plan last month; the stock closed down 2.1% on Thursday against a 6.4% decline for the KOSPI benchmark.
key_facts.excerpt: Hyundai Motor shares have fallen more than 30 per cent since local media first reported last month that the automaker planned to buy SoftBank's remaining stake in Boston Dynamics. On Thursday, Hyundai Motor shares closed down 2.1 per cent, compared with a 6.4 per cent decline for the benchmark KOSPI.

key_facts.fact: The put option was tied to a condition that SoftBank could sell its remaining stake if a US IPO did not take place by June 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: When SoftBank sold Boston Dynamics to Hyundai Motor Group in 2021, it retained some of its stake and signed a "put option" contract allowing it to sell the remaining stake if a U.S. initial public offering (IPO) did not take place by June this year.

stories.headline: Data-center operator Csquare raises $1.05B in IPO, pricing at $21 below its $23-$27 range

key_facts.fact: Csquare priced its IPO of 50 million shares at $21.00 each, expecting gross proceeds of approximately $1.05 billion, or $1.2075 billion if underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full.
key_facts.excerpt: DALLAS, July 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Csquare, Inc. ("Csquare") today announced the pricing of its initial public offering of 50,000,000 shares of its common stock at an initial public offering price of $21.00 per share. ... Csquare expects the gross proceeds of the offering to be approximately $1,050.0 million, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions, or $1,207.5 million if the underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full.

key_facts.fact: The $21 price came in below the marketed range of $23 to $27, valuing the Dallas-based company at about $3.25 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The Dallas-based company sold 50 million shares at $21 apiece, below its marketed range of $23 to $27, valuing it at about $3.25 billion.

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2019, Csquare owns and operates 64 data center sites across 21 metropolitan markets in North America and the UK, providing co-location and connectivity to enterprises, cloud providers and telecom companies.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2019, Csquare owns and operates 64 data center sites across 21 metropolitan markets in North America and the UK, providing co-location and connectivity services to enterprises, cloud providers and telecommunications companies, according to its IPO filing.

key_facts.fact: Shares were expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker 'CSQR' on July 16, with the offering closing July 17.
key_facts.excerpt: The shares are expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "CSQR" on July 16, 2026. The offering is expected to close on July 17, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

key_facts.fact: Csquare intends to use the net proceeds to repay a portion of its outstanding indebtedness and pay offering fees and expenses; backer Brookfield was considering buying a portion of the offering.
key_facts.excerpt: Brookfield the Dallas-based company's backer, is considering buying a portion of the offering, the report added. ... The company said it plans to use most of the IPO proceeds to repay debt, with the remainder allocated for general corporate purposes, including acquisitions, working capital and capital expenditures.

stories.headline: Apple hunts chip acquisitions to fix its AI servers as Baltra chip slips past 2026

key_facts.fact: The Information reported on July 15 that Apple has been in talks with bankers over recent months and has approached semiconductor startups to gauge their interest in selling, as it explores acquisitions to boost its AI server chip efforts.
key_facts.excerpt: According to The Information, Apple has been exploring potential acquisitions of semiconductor startups to "boost its efforts to build server chips for running AI." In recent months, the iPhone maker has talked with bankers about possible deals. It has also approached semiconductor startups to gauge their interest in selling themselves, the people said.

key_facts.fact: Apple's internal AI servers currently run on its own M2 Ultra chips and have struggled with performance on demanding workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple's hunt for chip acquisitions comes as the company struggles with the performance of its own internal AI servers, which currently run on internally designed M2 Ultra chips.

key_facts.fact: Apple's next-generation server chip, code-named Baltra, has slipped past its planned 2026 debut; it is being developed with Broadcom as a custom AI inference processor on TSMC's 3nm process.
key_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the problem is a chip known internally as "Baltra." Apple had planned to release a future version of this AI server chip this year, but that project has been delayed, according to sources speaking to The Information. Baltra is being developed in collaboration with Broadcom as a custom server processor for AI functions in the cloud. The chip is intended for AI inference and was to be built on TSMC's 3nm process.

key_facts.fact: The more demanding tasks for the new Siri are handled by a Gemini-based model running on Nvidia GPUs in Google Cloud, after Apple's Mac-based chips could not handle the large model.
key_facts.excerpt: Earlier this year, Apple attempted to run Google's Gemini models on its internal servers as part of a revamped Siri. However, the Mac-based chips could not handle the large model. As a result, Apple had to run parts of the revamped assistant on Nvidia chips in Google Cloud.

key_facts.fact: Apple rarely makes large acquisitions: it bought PA Semi for $278 million in 2008, Beats for $3 billion, and AI startup Q.ai for almost $2 billion this year; it had $45.6 billion in cash and equivalents as of the end of March.
key_facts.excerpt: It got into making its own chips in the first place after buying PA Semi for $278 million in 2008, but Apple doesn't typically splash much cash on acquisitions. It bought AI startup Q.ai for almost $2 billion this year. That was its second largest acquisition after the $3 billion it paid for Beats over a decade ago. ... As of the end of March, it had $45.6 billion in cash and cash equivalents.

key_facts.fact: Last week Apple struck a deal with Broadcom to buy $30 billion worth of chips made in the US, and Bloomberg reported this week that an M7 Ultra-based server chip won't be ready until 2029, though Apple will soon upgrade infrastructure with M5 Ultra chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg reported this week that a server chip based on the M7 Ultra won't be ready until 2029, but noted that Apple will soon upgrade its infrastructure with M5 Ultra chips. Apple reportedly planned to debut a next-gen server chip (codenamed "Baltra") this year, but that timeline appears to have slipped. Last week, Apple struck a deal with Broadcom to buy $30 billion worth of chips that the latter makes in the US.

stories.headline: Cadence launches AuraStack, an agentic AI platform for PCB and advanced chip packaging design

key_facts.fact: Cadence introduced the AuraStack AI Super Agent on Allegro AI Studio on July 15, calling it the world's first agentic AI platform for printed circuit board and advanced packaging design, accelerated by Nvidia Blackwell and CUDA-X.
key_facts.excerpt: Cadence (Nasdaq: CDNS) today introduced the AuraStack™ AI Super Agent on Cadence® Allegro® AI Studio, the world's first agentic AI platform for printed circuit board (PCB) and advanced packaging design, taking designers from system planning to final product in a single AI-native environment. The Cadence AuraStack AI Super Agent, accelerated by NVIDIA Blackwell and NVIDIA CUDA-X, coordinates domain-specific AI agents across planning, implementation and tightly integrated multiphysics analysis domains to compress the system-design cycle through manufacturing.

key_facts.fact: Cadence says the launch makes it the only provider with agentic AI spanning the full electronic system design flow — from digital and analog silicon design through advanced packaging to PCB design — building on its ChipStack, InnoStack and ViraStack agents.
key_facts.excerpt: With the AuraStack AI Super Agent, Cadence is now the only provider with agentic AI solutions spanning the full electronic system design flow, from digital and analog silicon design, advanced packaging, through to PCB design, building on its ChipStack™, InnoStack™ and ViraStack™ AI Super Agents.

key_facts.fact: Cadence claims AuraStack delivers two times faster time to market and 15 times higher productivity, according to corporate VP Ashutosh Mauskar.
key_facts.excerpt: The agent can deliver two times faster time to market and 15 times higher productivity, said Ashutosh Mauskar, corporate vice president for product management and business development at Cadence, in an interview with me.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia reported 20x faster multiphysics performance with AuraStack and the Millennium M2000 platform, while TSMC said years of collaboration with Cadence on substrate auto routing boosted productivity 100x.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia said it has seen a 20X faster multiphysics performance with AuraStack and the Millennium M2000 platform. Nvidia provides Blackwell and CUDA-X accelerators for AuraStack. ... TSMC said it has seen productivity boosted by 100 times over years of collaboration with Cadence on substrate auto routing.

key_facts.fact: Early customers include Nvidia, TSMC, Schneider Electric and Forvia Hella, which says AI-assisted component placement cut one design task involving roughly 300 components from four days to about four minutes.
key_facts.excerpt: That said, several early customer examples suggest there is massive potential. Forvia Hella says AI-assisted component placement reduced one design task involving roughly 300 components, from four days to approximately four minutes.

key_facts.fact: AuraStack functions as a natural language interface that plans and orchestrates multi-step circuit design and testing workflows running at higher precision on CPUs, GPUs and other accelerators, and integrates with a range of open and proprietary models.
key_facts.excerpt: In other words, the AI model — we're told AuraStack integrates with a wide range of open and proprietary models — functions as a natural language interface capable of planning and orchestrating complex multi-step circuit design and testing workflows that run at higher precision using CPUs, GPUs, and other accelerators.
